title: A Blind Esperantist's Trip to Finland and Sweden, to Attend the Fourteenth International Esperanto Congress

Merrick also shares engaging stories of the blind community’s involvement in the congress, their discussions, and the sharing of ideas, particularly in relation to the education and support for blind individuals.
